svg.aria-label: Process flow: headlines are made into preference pairs, training runs on 2 GPUs in Kaggle notebook 1, the merged model is served with vLLM in Kaggle notebook 2, and every answer is scored with a strict checker and a word-list classifier
svg.title: Process flow
svg.desc: Step 1, data: the twitter-financial-news-sentiment dataset has 9,543 training and 2,388 validation headlines, labelled bearish, bullish or neutral. Step 2, preference pairs: each of 2,000 training headlines has a chosen answer and a rejected answer. The chosen answer is the correct label in JSON. The rejected answer is a wrong label in JSON for 1,000 pairs, and a sentence with the correct label for the other 1,000. Kaggle notebook 1 is for training, on 2 T4 GPUs. Step 3, training: a LoRA adapter on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct is trained with Hugging Face TRL's DPOTrainer. The loss is DPO plus an SFT term on the chosen answers. Training is launched with Accelerate and DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 in fp16, and tracked in Weights and Biases. Step 4, merge: the adapter is merged into the base model. The 1 GB result is saved as the notebook's output, then uploaded to Hugging Face. Kaggle notebook 2 is for serving and scoring, on 2 T4 GPUs, and notebook 1's output is loaded into it. Step 5, serve: the base model and then the fine-tuned model are served with vLLM, each in its own process. Decoding is greedy, on 500 held-out validation headlines. Step 6, score: an answer is counted only if all of it parses as JSON with an allowed label. The valid-JSON rate and accuracy are computed from this check. A word-list label is also set from counts of bullish and bearish words. Answers with a different label are added to a review queue.

g.text: Process flow
Notebook 1's output is loaded into notebook 2.
Data
zeroshot/twitter-financial-news-sentiment (MIT licence)
9,543 training and 2,388 validation headlines, labelled bearish, bullish or neutral
Preference pairs
2,000 training headlines. Chosen answer: the correct label as JSON, {"label": "bullish"}
Rejected answer: a wrong label in JSON, or a sentence with the correct label (1,000 pairs each)
The label and the answer format are trained together
Kaggle notebook 1: training
2 T4 GPUs
Training
Hugging Face TRL DPOTrainer, LoRA rank 16, on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
Accelerate with DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 across both GPUs, in fp16 (T4s have no bf16)
Loss: DPO plus an SFT term on the chosen answers (32 pairs per step, 63 steps)
Loss and rewards logged to Weights & Biases
Merge
The adapter is merged into the base model (1 GB in fp16)
Saved as notebook output, then uploaded to Hugging Face
Kaggle notebook 2: serving and scoring
2 T4 GPUs
Serve
500 held-out validation headlines, served with vLLM and greedy decoding
The base model, then the fine-tuned model, each in its own process
Timing starts after an untimed run on 16 headlines, so start-up time is excluded
Score
Strict checker: an answer is counted only if all of it parses as JSON with an allowed label
Results: the valid-JSON rate and accuracy
Word-list classifier: a label from counts of bullish and bearish words
Answers with a different label are added to a review queue, as in Reconcile

svg.text: Code: src/finsent.py (pairs, checker, classifier and scoring), src/train_dpo.py, src/run_vllm.py and make_notebooks.py (for both notebooks).
